newsitem.title: USA: Today's Man Q4 same-store sales up 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Today's Man Q4 same-store sales up 8 pct.

text.p: Today's Man Inc said its same-store sales for the fourth quarter increased eight percent from the year-ago equivalent 13-week period.
The company also said that during the same period, its total sales fell 13 percent.

Same-store sales for the 13-week quarter increased 1.5 percent and total sales decreased 18 percent to $67.7 million from $82.7 million in the corresponding 14 week quarter of the prior year, the company said.
For the year ended February 1, the company said its same-store sales fell six percent and its total sales fell 21 percent.
